In Jpn. Profile Thiamylal sodium is a short-acting intravenous barbiturate an- aesthetic. It is possibly slightly more potent than thiopental sodi- um (p.1796) and has similar actions and uses. It has been used for the production of complete anaesthesia of short duration, for the induction of general anaesthesia, or for inducing a hypnotic state.
